newsitem.title: USA: ABC cuts about 200 jobs -- sources.
newsitem.headline: ABC cuts about 200 jobs -- sources.

text.p: ABC Inc has slashed about 200 jobs at the television network to cuts costs as it prepares its annual budget for parent Walt Disney Co, according to executives at the network.
A network spokeswoman confirmed that there were cutbacks, but declined to provide details.
"We can confirm that there were reductions as part of our normal budget process," the spokeswoman said. "We're constantly reassessing staffing and costs."
"It's always a difficult decision when you're making reductions," the spokeswoman added.
About 100 of the jobs were cut through attritition, while about 50 persons left through voluntary acceptance of severance packages and about 50 persons were dismissed, the executives said.
The cuts were across the board in all departments, including broadcast operations, sales, news, sports, marketing and research.
The network workforce totals about 5,000 persons, and the cuts would represent about four percent of the total.
The spokeswoman said no more layoffs were expected. The cuts came as the network completed its budget for the new fiscal year. The network's fiscal year ends in September.
